records.title: D3-AA Agent Authentication
records.description: Agent authentication is the process of verifying the identities of agents to ensure they are authorized and trustworthy participants within a system.

records.title: D3-ABPI Application-based Process Isolation
records.description: Application code which prevents its own subroutines from accessing intra-process / internal memory space.

records.title: D3-ACA Active Certificate Analysis
records.description: Actively collecting PKI certificates by connecting to the server and downloading its server certificates for analysis.

records.title: D3-ACH Application Configuration Hardening
records.description: Modifying an application's configuration to reduce its attack surface.

records.title: D3-AEM Application Exception Monitoring
records.description: Monitoring the failures of system counters and timers.

records.title: D3-AH Application Hardening
records.description: Application Hardening makes an executable application more resilient to a class of exploits which either introduce new code or execute unwanted existing code. These techniques may be applied at compile-time or on an application binary.

records.title: D3-AI Asset Inventory
records.description: Asset inventorying identifies and records the organization's assets and enriches each inventory item with knowledge about their vulnerabilities.

records.title: D3-AL Account Locking
records.description: The process of temporarily disabling user accounts on a system or domain.

records.title: D3-ALLM Active Logical Link Mapping
records.description: Active logical link mapping sends and receives network traffic as a means to map the whole data link layer, where the links represent logical data flows rather than physical connection

records.title: D3-AM Access Modeling
records.description: Access modeling captures and records the access permissions granted to identities (e.g., administrators, users, groups, systems) and optionally includes details on how these identities are stored, managed, and shared across systems.

records.title: D3-AMED Access Mediation
records.description: Access mediation is the process of granting or denying specific requests to: 1) obtain and use information and related information processing services; and 2) enter specific physical facilities (e.g., Federal buildings, military establishments, border crossing entrances). Access mediation decisions should enforce least privilege by granting access for scoped durations to prevent privilege creep and, where applicable, implement just-in-time (JIT) access. Denial decisions may prevent initial access or terminate access that has already been granted, ensuring continuous enforcement of security policies.

records.title: D3-ANAA Administrative Network Activity Analysis
records.description: Detection of unauthorized use of administrative network protocols by analyzing network activity against a baseline.

records.title: D3-ANCI Authentication Cache Invalidation
records.description: Removing tokens or credentials from an authentication cache to prevent further user associated account accesses.

records.title: D3-ANET Authentication Event Thresholding
records.description: Collecting authentication events, creating a baseline user profile, and determining whether authentication events are consistent with the baseline profile.

records.title: D3-APA Access Policy Administration
records.description: Access policy administration is the systematic process of defining, implementing, and managing access control policies that dictate user permissions to resources.

records.title: D3-APCA Application Protocol Command Analysis
records.description: Analyzing application protocol level remote commands to detect unauthorized activity.

records.title: D3-APLM Active Physical Link Mapping
records.description: Active physical link mapping sends and receives network traffic as a means to map the physical layer.

records.title: D3-APM Application Performance Monitoring
records.description: Monitoring the count and duration of the application or program cycle.

records.title: D3-AVE Asset Vulnerability Enumeration
records.description: Asset vulnerability enumeration enriches inventory items with knowledge identifying their vulnerabilities.

records.title: D3-AZET Authorization Event Thresholding
records.description: Collecting authorization events, creating a baseline user profile, and determining whether authorization events are consistent with the baseline profile.

records.title: D3-BA Bootloader Authentication
records.description: Cryptographically authenticating the bootloader software before system boot.

records.title: D3-BAN Biometric Authentication
records.description: Using biological measures in order to authenticate a user.

records.title: D3-BDI Broadcast Domain Isolation
records.description: Broadcast isolation restricts the number of computers a host can contact on their LAN.

records.title: D3-BMA Bus Message Authentication
records.description: Applies cryptographic primitives to individual bus frames to verify the sender's identity and ensure the integrity of the data payload.

records.title: D3-BSE Byte Sequence Emulation
records.description: Analyzing sequences of bytes and determining if they likely represent malicious shellcode.

records.title: D3-CA Certificate Analysis
records.description: Analyzing Public Key Infrastructure certificates to detect if they have been misconfigured or spoofed using both network traffic, certificate fields and third-party logs.

records.title: D3-CAA Connection Attempt Analysis
records.description: Analyzing failed connections in a network to detect unauthorized activity.

records.title: D3-CBAN Certificate-based Authentication
records.description: Requiring a digital certificate in order to authenticate a user.

records.title: D3-CCSA Credential Compromise Scope Analysis
records.description: Determining which credentials may have been compromised by analyzing the user logon history of a particular system.

records.title: D3-CDP Change Default Password
records.description: Changing the default password means replacing the factory-set credentials with a strong, unique password before the device is deployed, preventing unauthorized access.

records.title: D3-CE Credential Eviction
records.description: Credential Eviction techniques disable or remove compromised credentials from a computer network.

records.title: D3-CERO Certificate Rotation
records.description: Certificate rotation involves replacing digital certificates and their private keys to maintain cryptographic integrity and trust, mitigating key compromise risks and ensuring continuous secure communications.

records.title: D3-CF Content Filtering
records.description: Content Filtering techniques aid in the process of analyzing an input file for malicious or erroneous content and outputting a sanitized version.

records.title: D3-CFC Content Format Conversion
records.description: Content format conversion is mechanical transformation from one format to another which may be normalization or specifically flattening.

records.title: D3-CFI Control Flow Integrity
records.description: Enforcing legal control flow transfers during application process execution.

records.title: D3-CH Credential Hardening
records.description: Credential Hardening techniques modify system or network properties in order to protect system or network/domain credentials.

records.title: D3-CHN Connected Honeynet
records.description: A decoy service, system, or environment, that is connected to the enterprise network, and simulates or emulates certain functionality to the network, without exposing full access to a production system.

records.title: D3-CI Configuration Inventory
records.description: Configuration inventory identifies and records the configuration of software and hardware and their components throughout the organization.

records.title: D3-CIA Container Image Analysis
records.description: Analyzing a Container Image with respect to a set of policies.

records.title: D3-CM Content Modification
records.description: Modify content that does not comply with policy.

records.title: D3-CNE Content Excision
records.description: Removing specific, potentially malicious, parts of content

records.title: D3-CNR Content Rebuild
records.description: Rebuild the file according to the spec so any unreferenced components or objects are removed.

records.title: D3-CNS Content Substitution
records.description: Modifies specific digital content information by replacing it with something else.

records.title: D3-CP Certificate Pinning
records.description: Persisting either a server's X.509 certificate or their public key and comparing that to server's presented identity to allow for greater client confidence in the remote server's identity for SSL connections.

records.title: D3-CQ Content Quarantine
records.description: Transfer content that does not comply with policy to a quarantine zone.

records.title: D3-CR Credential Revocation
records.description: Deleting a set of credentials permanently to prevent them from being used to authenticate.

records.title: D3-CRO Credential Rotation
records.description: Credential rotation is a security procedure in which authentication credentials, such as passwords, API keys, or certificates, are regularly changed or replaced to minimize the risk of unauthorized access.

records.title: D3-CS Credential Scrubbing
records.description: The systematic removal of hard-coded credentials from source code to prevent accidental exposure and unauthorized access.

records.title: D3-CSPP Client-server Payload Profiling
records.description: Comparing client-server request and response payloads to a baseline profile to identify outliers.

records.title: D3-CTS Credential Transmission Scoping
records.description: Limiting the transmission of a credential to a scoped set of relying parties.

records.title: D3-CV Content Validation
records.description: Verify and validate contents complies with policy

records.title: D3-DA Dynamic Analysis
records.description: Executing or opening a file in a synthetic "sandbox" environment to determine if the file is a malicious program or if the file exploits another program such as a document reader.

records.title: D3-DAM Domain Account Monitoring
records.description: Monitoring the existence of or changes to Domain User Accounts.

records.title: D3-DCE Dead Code Elimination
records.description: Removing unreachable or "dead code" from compiled source code.

records.title: D3-DE Decoy Environment
records.description: A Decoy Environment comprises hosts and networks for the purposes of deceiving an attacker.

records.title: D3-DEM Data Exchange Mapping
records.description: Data exchange mapping identifies and models the organization's intended design for the flows of the data types, formats, and volumes between systems at the application layer.

records.title: D3-DENCR Disk Encryption
records.description: Encrypting a hard disk partition to prevent cleartext access to a file system.

records.title: D3-DF Decoy File
records.description: A file created for the purposes of deceiving an adversary.

records.title: D3-DI Data Inventory
records.description: Data inventorying identifies and records the schemas, formats, volumes, and locations of data stored and used on the organization's architecture.

records.title: D3-DKE Disk Erasure
records.description: Disk Erasure is the process of securely deleting all data on a disk to ensure that it cannot be recovered by any means.

records.title: D3-DKF Disk Formatting
records.description: Disk Formatting is the process of preparing a data storage device, such as a hard drive, solid-state drive, or USB flash drive, for initial use.

records.title: D3-DKP Disk Partitioning
records.description: Disk Partitioning is the process of dividing a disk into multiple distinct sections, known as partitions.

records.title: D3-DLIC Driver Load Integrity Checking
records.description: Ensuring the integrity of drivers loaded during initialization of the operating system.

records.title: D3-DLV Domain Logic Validation
records.description: Validation of variable state in the context of the domain application.

records.title: D3-DNL Directional Network Link
records.description: Enforce one-way network communication by preventing two-way communication.

records.title: D3-DNR Decoy Network Resource
records.description: Deploying a network resource for the purposes of deceiving an adversary.

records.title: D3-DNRA Domain Name Reputation Analysis
records.description: Analyzing the reputation of a domain name.

records.title: D3-DNSAL DNS Allowlisting
records.description: Permitting only approved domains and their subdomains to be resolved.

records.title: D3-DNSCE DNS Cache Eviction
records.description: Flushing DNS to clear any IP addresses or other DNS records from the cache.

records.title: D3-DNSDL DNS Denylisting
records.description: Blocking DNS Network Traffic based on criteria such as IP address, domain name, or DNS query type.

records.title: D3-DNSTA DNS Traffic Analysis
records.description: Analysis of domain name metadata, including name and DNS records, to determine whether the domain is likely to resolve to an undesirable host.

records.title: D3-DO Decoy Object
records.description: A Decoy Object is created and deployed for the purposes of deceiving attackers.

records.title: D3-DP Decoy Persona
records.description: Establishing a fake online identity to misdirect, deceive, and or interact with adversaries.

records.title: D3-DPLM Direct Physical Link Mapping
records.description: Direct physical link mapping creates a physical link map by direct observation and recording of the physical network links.

records.title: D3-DPR Decoy Public Release
records.description: Issuing publicly released media to deceive adversaries.

records.title: D3-DQSA Database Query String Analysis
records.description: Analyzing database queries to detect [SQL Injection](https://capec.mitre.org/data/definitions/66.html).

records.title: D3-DRA Disable Remote Access
records.description: Limiting access to a computing device which is not required through or from a non-organization-controlled network.

records.title: D3-DRT Domain Registration Takedown
records.description: The process of performing a takedown of the attacker's domain registration infrastructure.

records.title: D3-DST Decoy Session Token
records.description: An authentication token created for the purposes of deceiving an adversary.

records.title: D3-DTP Domain Trust Policy
records.description: Restricting inter-domain trust by modifying domain configuration.

records.title: D3-DUC Decoy User Credential
records.description: A Credential created for the purpose of deceiving an adversary.

records.title: D3-EAL Executable Allowlisting
records.description: Using a digital signature to authenticate a file before opening.

records.title: D3-EBWSAM Endpoint-based Web Server Access Mediation
records.description: Endpoint-based web server access mediation regulates web server access directly from user endpoints by implementing mechanisms such as client-side certificates and endpoint security software to authenticate devices and ensure compliant access.

records.title: D3-EDL Executable Denylisting
records.description: Blocking the execution of files on a host in accordance with defined application policy rules.

records.title: D3-EF Email Filtering
records.description: Filtering incoming email traffic based on specific criteria.

records.title: D3-EFA Emulated File Analysis
records.description: Emulating instructions in a file looking for specific patterns.

records.title: D3-EHB Endpoint Health Beacon
records.description: Monitoring the security status of an endpoint by sending periodic messages with health status, where absence of a response may indicate that the endpoint has been compromised.

records.title: D3-EHPV Exception Handler Pointer Validation
records.description: Validates that a referenced exception handler pointer is a valid exception handler.

records.title: D3-EI Execution Isolation
records.description: Execution Isolation techniques prevent application processes from accessing non-essential system resources, such as memory, devices, or files.

records.title: D3-ELM Electronic Lock Monitoring
records.description: Monitoring electronic lock and door hardware states and access events (e.g., locked/unlocked, access granted/denied, door forced/held, tamper) to detect and respond to unauthorized entry.

records.title: D3-EMH Electromagnetic Radiation Hardening
records.description: The application of physical and material-level design measures to electronic systems, components, or facilities to reduce their susceptibility to damage or disruption from electromagnetic threats.

records.title: D3-EPL Physical Locking
records.description: Employ a mechanical locking device for securing moveable portions of physical barriers (e.g., doors, gates, drawers) in a secured position.

records.title: D3-ER Email Removal
records.description: The email removal technique deletes email files from system storage.

records.title: D3-ET Encrypted Tunnels
records.description: Encrypted encapsulation of routable network traffic.

records.title: D3-FA File Analysis
records.description: File Analysis is an analytic process to determine a file's status. For example: virus, trojan, benign, malicious, trusted, unauthorized, sensitive, etc.

records.title: D3-FAPA File Access Pattern Analysis
records.description: Analyzing the files accessed by a process to identify unauthorized activity.

records.title: D3-FBA Firmware Behavior Analysis
records.description: Analyzing the behavior of embedded code in firmware and looking for anomalous behavior and suspicious activity.

records.title: D3-FC File Carving
records.description: Identifying and extracting files from network application protocols through the use of network stream reassembly software.

records.title: D3-FCA File Creation Analysis
records.description: Analyzing the properties of file create system call invocations.

records.title: D3-FCDC File Content Decompression Checking
records.description: Checking if compressed or encoded data sections can be successfully decompressed or decoded. Can follow with further analysis with semantic knowledge

records.title: D3-FCOA File Content Analysis
records.description: Employing a pattern matching algorithm to statically analyze the content of files.

records.title: D3-FCR File Content Rules
records.description: Employing a pattern matching rule language to analyze the content of files.

records.title: D3-FE File Encryption
records.description: Encrypting a file using a cryptographic key.

records.title: D3-FEMC Firmware Embedded Monitoring Code
records.description: Monitoring code is injected into firmware for integrity monitoring of firmware and firmware data.

records.title: D3-FEV File Eviction
records.description: File eviction techniques delete files from system storage.

records.title: D3-FFV File Format Verification
records.description: Verifying that a file conforms to its expected format specifications

records.title: D3-FH File Hashing
records.description: Employing file hash comparisons to detect known malware.

records.title: D3-FHRA File Hash Reputation Analysis
records.description: Analyzing the reputation of a file hash.

records.title: D3-FIM File Integrity Monitoring
records.description: Detecting any suspicious changes to files in a computer system.

records.title: D3-FISV File Internal Structure Verification
records.description: The process of checking specific static values within a file, such as file signatures or magic numbers, to ensure they match the expected values defined by the file format specification.

records.title: D3-FMBV File Magic Byte Verification
records.description: Utilizing the magic number to verify the file

records.title: D3-FMCV File Metadata Consistency Validation
records.description: The process of validating the consistency between a file's metadata and its actual content, ensuring that elements like declared lengths, pointers, and checksums accurately describe the file's content.

records.title: D3-FMVV File Metadata Value Verification
records.description: The process of checking specific static values within a file, such as file signatures or magic numbers, to ensure they match the expected values defined by the file format specification.

records.title: D3-FRDDL Forward Resolution Domain Denylisting
records.description: Blocking a lookup based on the query's domain name value.

records.title: D3-FRIDL Forward Resolution IP Denylisting
records.description: Blocking a DNS lookup's answer's IP address value.

records.title: D3-FV Firmware Verification
records.description: Cryptographically verifying firmware integrity.

records.title: D3-HBPI Hardware-based Process Isolation
records.description: Preventing one process from writing to the memory space of another process through hardware based address manager implementations.

records.title: D3-HBWP Hardware-based Write Protection
records.description: Physical methods of preventing data from being written to computer storage.

records.title: D3-HCI Hardware Component Inventory
records.description: Hardware component inventorying identifies and records the hardware items in the organization's architecture.

records.title: D3-HD Homoglyph Detection
records.description: Comparing strings using a variety of techniques to determine if a deceptive or malicious string is being presented to a user.

records.title: D3-HDDL Hierarchical Domain Denylisting
records.description: Blocking the resolution of any subdomain of a specified domain name.

records.title: D3-HDL Homoglyph Denylisting
records.description: Blocking DNS queries that are deceptively similar to legitimate domain names.

records.title: D3-HR Host Reboot
records.description: Initiating a host's reboot sequence to terminate all running processes.

records.title: D3-HS Host Shutdown
records.description: Initiating a host's shutdown sequence to terminate all running processes.

records.title: D3-IAA Identifier Activity Analysis
records.description: Taking known malicious identifiers and determining if they are present in a system.

records.title: D3-IBCA Indirect Branch Call Analysis
records.description: Analyzing vendor specific branch call recording in order to detect ROP style attacks.

records.title: D3-ID Identifier Analysis
records.description: Analyzing identifier artifacts such as IP address, domain names, or URL(I)s.

records.title: D3-IDA Input Device Analysis
records.description: Operating system level mechanisms to prevent abusive input device exploitation.

records.title: D3-IHN Integrated Honeynet
records.description: The practice of setting decoys in a production environment to entice interaction from attackers.

records.title: D3-IOPR IO Port Restriction
records.description: Limiting access to computer input/output (IO) ports to restrict unauthorized devices.

records.title: D3-IPCTA IPC Traffic Analysis
records.description: Analyzing standard inter process communication (IPC) protocols to detect deviations from normal protocol activity.

records.title: D3-IPRA IP Reputation Analysis
records.description: Analyzing the reputation of an IP address.

records.title: D3-IRA Identifier Reputation Analysis
records.description: Analyzing the reputation of an identifier.

records.title: D3-IRV Integer Range Validation
records.description: Ensuring that an integer is within a valid range.

records.title: D3-ISVA Inbound Session Volume Analysis
records.description: Analyzing inbound network session or connection attempt volume.

records.title: D3-ITF Inbound Traffic Filtering
records.description: Restricting network traffic originating from untrusted networks destined towards a private host or enclave.

records.title: D3-JFAPA Job Function Access Pattern Analysis
records.description: Detecting anomalies in user access patterns by comparing user access activity to behavioral profiles that categorize users by role such as job title, function, department.

records.title: D3-KBPI Kernel-based Process Isolation
records.description: Using kernel-level capabilities to isolate processes.

records.title: D3-LAM Local Account Monitoring
records.description: Analyzing local user accounts to detect unauthorized activity.

records.title: D3-LAMED LAN Access Mediation
records.description: LAN access mediation encompasses the application of strict access control policies, systematic verification of devices, and authentication mechanisms to govern connectivity to a Local Area Network.

records.title: D3-LFAM Local File Access Mediation
records.description: Local file access mediation is the process of an operating system granting or denying a specific access request to a local file.

records.title: D3-LFP Local File Permissions
records.description: Local file permissions is the systematic process of defining, implementing, and managing access control policies that dictate user permissions for accessing files on a local system through the configuration of operating system functionality.

records.title: D3-LLM Logical Link Mapping
records.description: Logical link mapping creates a model of existing or previous node-to-node connections using network-layer data or metadata.

records.title: D3-MA Message Analysis
records.description: Analyzing email or instant message content to detect unauthorized activity.

records.title: D3-MAN Message Authentication
records.description: Authenticating the sender of a message and ensuring message integrity.

records.title: D3-MBSV Memory Block Start Validation
records.description: Ensuring that a pointer accurately references the beginning of a designated memory block.

records.title: D3-MBT Memory Boundary Tracking
records.description: Analyzing a call stack for return addresses which point to unexpected memory locations.

records.title: D3-MENCR Message Encryption
records.description: Encrypting a message body using a cryptographic key.

records.title: D3-MFA Multi-factor Authentication
records.description: Requiring proof of two or more pieces of evidence in order to authenticate a user.

records.title: D3-MH Message Hardening
records.description: The application of security controls to user-to-user and system-to-system communications so messages remain confidential, unaltered, and verifiable while resisting injection, replay, and tampering.

records.title: D3-MSM Motion Sensor Monitoring
records.description: Monitoring events from motion detectors (e.g., passive IR, microwave, dual-technology) to detect presence or movement within protected areas.

records.title: D3-NAM Network Access Mediation
records.description: Network access mediation is the control method for authorizing access to a system by a user (or a process acting on behalf of a user) communicating through a network, including a local area network, a wide area network, and the Internet.

records.title: D3-NI Network Isolation
records.description: Network Isolation techniques prevent network hosts from accessing non-essential system network resources.

records.title: D3-NM Network Mapping
records.description: Network mapping encompasses the techniques to identify and model the physical layer, network layer, and data exchange layers of the organization's network and their physical location, and determine allowed pathways through that network.

records.title: D3-NNI Network Node Inventory
records.description: Network node inventorying identifies and records all the network nodes (hosts, routers, switches, firewalls, etc.) in the organization's architecture.

records.title: D3-NPC Null Pointer Checking
records.description: Checking if a pointer is NULL.

records.title: D3-NRAM Network Resource Access Mediation
records.description: Control of access to organizational systems and services by users or processes over a network.

records.title: D3-NTA Network Traffic Analysis
records.description: Analyzing intercepted or summarized computer network traffic to detect unauthorized activity.

records.title: D3-NTCD Network Traffic Community Deviation
records.description: Establishing baseline communities of network hosts and identifying statistically divergent inter-community communication.

records.title: D3-NTF Network Traffic Filtering
records.description: Restricting network traffic originating from any location.

records.title: D3-NTPM Network Traffic Policy Mapping
records.description: Network traffic policy mapping identifies and models the allowed pathways of data at the network, transport, and/or application levels.

records.title: D3-NTSA Network Traffic Signature Analysis
records.description: Analyzing network traffic and compares it to known signatures

records.title: D3-NVA Network Vulnerability Assessment
records.description: Network vulnerability assessment relates all the vulnerabilities of a network's components in the context of their configuration and interdependencies and can also include assessing risk emerging from the network's design as a whole, not just the sum of individual network node or network segment vulnerabilities.

records.title: D3-OAM Operational Activity Mapping
records.description: Operational activity mapping identifies activities of the organization and the organization's suborganizations, groups, roles, and individuals that carry out the activities and then establishes the dependencies of the activities on the systems and people that perform those activities.

records.title: D3-ODM Operational Dependency Mapping
records.description: Operational dependency mapping identifies and models the dependencies of the organization's activities on each other and on the organization's performers (people, systems, and services.) This may include modeling the higher- and lower-level activities of an organization forming a hierarchy, or layering, of the dependencies in an organization's activities.

records.title: D3-OE Object Eviction
records.description: Terminate or remove an object from a host machine. This is the broadest class for object eviction.

records.title: D3-OLV Operational Logic Validation
records.description: Validation of variable state in the context of the control logic of the operational application.

records.title: D3-OM Organization Mapping
records.description: Organization mapping identifies and models the people, roles, and groups with an organization and the relations between them.

records.title: D3-OMM Operating Mode Monitoring
records.description: Detects operating modes such as Program, Run, Remote, or Stop.

records.title: D3-OPM Operational Process Monitoring
records.description: Monitoring physical parameters and operator actions related to an operational environment.

records.title: D3-OPR Operating Mode Restriction
records.description: Restricting unauthorized changes to the operating mode prevents devices from switching into inappropriate or vulnerable states during normal use.

records.title: D3-ORA Operational Risk Assessment
records.description: Operational risk assessment identifies and models the vulnerabilities of, and risks to, an organization's activities individually and as a whole.

records.title: D3-OSM Operating System Monitoring
records.description: The operating system software, for D3FEND's purposes, includes the kernel and its process management functions, hardware drivers, initialization or boot logic. It also includes and other key system daemons and their configuration. The monitoring or analysis of these components for unauthorized activity constitute **Operating System Monitoring**.

records.title: D3-OTF Outbound Traffic Filtering
records.description: Restricting network traffic originating from a private host or enclave destined towards untrusted networks.

records.title: D3-OTP One-time Password
records.description: A one-time password is valid for only one user authentication.

records.title: D3-OVAR OT Variable Access Restriction
records.description: Assign read/write access controls on designated registers or data tags to prevent unauthorized writes.

records.title: D3-PA Process Analysis
records.description: Process Analysis consists of observing a running application process and analyzing it to watch for certain behaviors or conditions which may indicate adversary activity. Analysis can occur inside of the process or through a third-party monitoring application. Examples include monitoring system and privileged calls, monitoring process initiation chains, and memory boundary allocations.

records.title: D3-PAM Physical Access Mediation
records.description: Physical access mediation is the process of granting or denying specific requests to enter specific physical facilities (e.g., Federal buildings, military establishments, border crossing entrances.)

records.title: D3-PAN Pointer Authentication
records.description: Comparing the cryptographic hash or derivative of a pointer's value to an expected value.

records.title: D3-PBWSAM Proxy-based Web Server Access Mediation
records.description: Proxy-based web server access mediation focuses on the regulation of web server access through intermediary proxy servers.

records.title: D3-PCA Passive Certificate Analysis
records.description: Collecting host certificates from network traffic or other passive sources like a certificate transparency log and analyzing them for unauthorized activity.

records.title: D3-PCSV Process Code Segment Verification
records.description: Comparing the "text" or "code" memory segments to a source of truth.

records.title: D3-PE Process Eviction
records.description: Process eviction techniques terminate or remove running process.

records.title: D3-PEH Physical Enclosure Hardening
records.description: Physical changes to a computer enclosure which reduce the ability for agents or the environment to affect the contained computer system.

records.title: D3-PFV Peripheral Firmware Verification
records.description: Cryptographically verifying peripheral firmware integrity.

records.title: D3-PH Platform Hardening
records.description: Hardening components of a Platform with the intention of making them more difficult to exploit. Platforms includes components such as: * BIOS UEFI Subsystems * Hardware security devices such as Trusted Platform Modules * Boot process logic or code * Kernel software components

records.title: D3-PHAM Physical Access Monitoring
records.description: Monitoring the physical access of a specified environment through detection, recording, reviewing, and logging of who/what enters and exists areas.

records.title: D3-PHDURA Per Host Download-Upload Ratio Analysis
records.description: Detecting anomalies that indicate malicious activity by comparing the amount of data downloaded versus data uploaded by a host.

records.title: D3-PLA Process Lineage Analysis
records.description: Identification of suspicious processes executing on an end-point device by examining the ancestry and siblings of a process, and the associated metadata of each node on the tree, such as process execution, duration, and order relative to siblings and ancestors.

records.title: D3-PLLM Passive Logical Link Mapping
records.description: Passive logical link mapping only listens to network traffic as a means to map the whole data link layer, where the links represent logical data flows rather than physical connections.

records.title: D3-PLM Physical Link Mapping
records.description: Physical link mapping identifies and models the link connectivity of the network devices within a physical network.

records.title: D3-PM Platform Monitoring
records.description: Monitoring platform components such as operating systems software, hardware devices, or firmware.

records.title: D3-PMAD Protocol Metadata Anomaly Detection
records.description: Collecting network communication protocol metadata and identifying statistical outliers.

records.title: D3-PR Password Rotation
records.description: Password rotation is a security policy that mandates the periodic change of user account passwords to mitigate the risk of unauthorized access due to compromised credentials.

records.title: D3-PS Process Suspension
records.description: Suspending a running process on a computer system.

records.title: D3-PSA Process Spawn Analysis
records.description: Analyzing spawn arguments or attributes of a process to detect processes that are unauthorized.

records.title: D3-PSEP Process Segment Execution Prevention
records.description: Preventing execution of any address in a memory region other than the code segment.

records.title: D3-PSM Proximity Sensor Monitoring
records.description: Monitoring events from proximity sensors that indicate a credential or tagged asset is within the sensor’s read range or a defined zone. Common enabling technologies include RFID, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), and Ultra-Wideband (UWB).

records.title: D3-PSMD Process Self-Modification Detection
records.description: Detects processes that modify, change, or replace their own code at runtime.

records.title: D3-PT Process Termination
records.description: Terminating a running application process on a computer system.

records.title: D3-PUM Platform Uptime Monitoring
records.description: Monitor the amount of time since the last power cycle or restart.

records.title: D3-PV Pointer Validation
records.description: Ensuring that a pointer variable has the required properties for use.

records.title: D3-PWA Password Authentication
records.description: Password authentication is a security mechanism used to verify the identity of a user or entity attempting to access a system or resource by requiring the input of a secret string of characters, known as a password, that is associated with the user or entity.

records.title: D3-RA Restore Access
records.description: Restoring an entity's access to resources.

records.title: D3-RAM Routing Access Mediation
records.description: Routing access mediation is a network security approach that manages and controls access at the network layer using VPNs, tunneling protocols, firewall rules, and traffic inspection to ensure secure and efficient data routing.

records.title: D3-RAPA Resource Access Pattern Analysis
records.description: Analyzing the resources accessed by a user to identify unauthorized activity.

records.title: D3-RC Restore Configuration
records.description: Restoring an software configuration.

records.title: D3-RD Restore Database
records.description: Restoring the data in a database.

records.title: D3-RDI Restore Disk Image
records.description: Restoring a previously captured disk image a hard drive.

records.title: D3-RE Restore Email
records.description: Restoring an email for an entity to access.

records.title: D3-RF Restore File
records.description: Restoring a file for an entity to access.

records.title: D3-RFAM Remote File Access Mediation
records.description: Remote file access mediation is the process of managing and securing access to file systems over a network to ensure that only authorized users or processes can interact with remote files.

records.title: D3-RFS RF Shielding
records.description: Adding physical barriers to a platform to prevent undesired radio interference.

records.title: D3-RFUM Remote Firmware Update Monitoring
records.description: Monitoring of remote firmware update commands to identify unauthorized software installations.

records.title: D3-RH Radiation Hardening
records.description: Radiation hardening is the process of making electronic components and circuits resistant to damage or malfunction caused by high levels of ionizing radiation.

records.title: D3-RIC Reissue Credential
records.description: Issue a new credential to a user which supersedes their old credential.

records.title: D3-RKD Registry Key Deletion
records.description: Delete a registry key.

records.title: D3-RN Reference Nullification
records.description: Invalidating all pointers that reference a specific memory block, ensuring that the block cannot be accessed or modified after deallocation.

records.title: D3-RNA Restore Network Access
records.description: Restoring a entity's access to a computer network.

records.title: D3-RO Restore Object
records.description: Restoring an object for an entity to access. This is the broadest class for object restoral.

records.title: D3-RPA Relay Pattern Analysis
records.description: The detection of an internal host relaying traffic between the internal network and the external network.

records.title: D3-RRID Reverse Resolution IP Denylisting
records.description: Blocking a reverse lookup based on the query's IP address value.

records.title: D3-RS Restore Software
records.description: Restoring software to a host.

records.title: D3-RTA RPC Traffic Analysis
records.description: Monitoring the activity of remote procedure calls in communication traffic to establish standard protocol operations and potential attacker activities.

records.title: D3-RTSD Remote Terminal Session Detection
records.description: Detection of an unauthorized remote live terminal console session by examining network traffic to a network host.

records.title: D3-RUAA Restore User Account Access
records.description: Restoring a user account's access to resources.

records.title: D3-SAOR Segment Address Offset Randomization
records.description: Randomizing the base (start) address of one or more segments of memory during the initialization of a process.

records.title: D3-SBV Service Binary Verification
records.description: Analyzing changes in service binary files by comparing to a source of truth.

records.title: D3-SCA System Call Analysis
records.description: Analyzing system calls to determine whether a process is exhibiting unauthorized behavior.

records.title: D3-SCF System Call Filtering
records.description: Controlling access to local computer system resources with kernel-level capabilities.

records.title: D3-SCH Source Code Hardening
records.description: Hardening source code with the intention of making it more difficult to exploit and less error prone.

records.title: D3-SCP System Configuration Permissions
records.description: Restricting system configuration modifications to a specific user or group of users.

records.title: D3-SDA Session Duration Analysis
records.description: Analyzing the duration of user sessions in order to detect unauthorized activity.

records.title: D3-SDM System Daemon Monitoring
records.description: Tracking changes to the state or configuration of critical system level processes.

records.title: D3-SEA Script Execution Analysis
records.description: Analyzing the execution of a script to detect unauthorized user activity.

records.title: D3-SFA System File Analysis
records.description: Monitoring system files such as authentication databases, configuration files, system logs, and system executables for modification or tampering.

records.title: D3-SFCV Stack Frame Canary Validation
records.description: Comparing a value stored in a stack frame with a known good value in order to prevent or detect a memory segment overwrite.

records.title: D3-SFV System Firmware Verification
records.description: Cryptographically verifying installed system firmware integrity.

records.title: D3-SHN Standalone Honeynet
records.description: An environment created for the purpose of attracting attackers and eliciting their behaviors that is not connected to any production enterprise systems.

records.title: D3-SICA System Init Config Analysis
records.description: Analysis of any system process startup configuration.

records.title: D3-SJA Scheduled Job Analysis
records.description: Analysis of source files, processes, destination files, or destination servers associated with a scheduled job to detect unauthorized use of job scheduling.

records.title: D3-SMRA Sender MTA Reputation Analysis
records.description: Characterizing the reputation of mail transfer agents (MTA) to determine the security risk in emails.

records.title: D3-SPP Strong Password Policy
records.description: Modifying system configuration to increase password strength.

records.title: D3-SRA Sender Reputation Analysis
records.description: Ascertaining sender reputation based on information associated with a message (e.g. email/instant messaging).

records.title: D3-SSC Shadow Stack Comparisons
records.description: Comparing a call stack in system memory with a shadow call stack maintained by the processor to determine unauthorized shellcode activity.

records.title: D3-ST Session Termination
records.description: Forcefully end all active sessions associated with compromised accounts or devices.

records.title: D3-SU Software Update
records.description: Replacing old software on a computer system component.

records.title: D3-SVCDM Service Dependency Mapping
records.description: Service dependency mapping determines the services on which each given service relies.

records.title: D3-SWI Software Inventory
records.description: Software inventorying identifies and records the software items in the organization's architecture.

records.title: D3-SYSDM System Dependency Mapping
records.description: System dependency mapping identifies and models the dependencies of system components on each other to carry out their function.

records.title: D3-SYSM System Mapping
records.description: System mapping encompasses the techniques to identify the organization's systems, how they are configured and decomposed into subsystems and components, how they are dependent on one another, and where they are physically located.

records.title: D3-SYSVA System Vulnerability Assessment
records.description: System vulnerability assessment relates all the vulnerabilities of a system's components in the context of their configuration and internal dependencies and can also include assessing risk emerging from the system's design as a whole, not just the sum of individual component vulnerabilities.

records.title: D3-TAAN Transfer Agent Authentication
records.description: Validating that server components of a messaging infrastructure are authorized to send a particular message.

records.title: D3-TB Token Binding
records.description: Token binding is a security mechanism used to enhance the protection of tokens, such as cookies or OAuth tokens, by binding them to a specific connection.

records.title: D3-TBA Token-based Authentication
records.description: Token-based authentication is an authentication protocol where users verify their identity in exchange for a unique access token. Users can then access the website, application, or resource for the life of the token without having to re-enter their credentials.

records.title: D3-TBI TPM Boot Integrity
records.description: Assuring the integrity of a platform by demonstrating that the boot process starts from a trusted combination of hardware and software and continues until the operating system has fully booted and applications are running. Sometimes called Static Root of Trust Measurement (STRM).

records.title: D3-TL Trusted Library
records.description: A trusted library is a collection of pre-verified and secure code modules or components that are used within software applications to perform specific functions. These libraries are considered reliable and have been vetted for security vulnerabilities, ensuring they do not introduce risks into the application.

records.title: D3-UA URL Analysis
records.description: Determining if a URL is benign or malicious by analyzing the URL or its components.

records.title: D3-UAP User Account Permissions
records.description: Restricting a user account's access to resources.

records.title: D3-UBA User Behavior Analysis
records.description: User behavior analytics ("UBA") as defined by Gartner, is a cybersecurity process about detection of insider threats, targeted attacks, and financial fraud. UBA solutions look at patterns of human behavior, and then apply algorithms and statistical analysis to detect meaningful anomalies from those patterns-anomalies that indicate potential threats.' Instead of tracking devices or security events, UBA tracks a system's users. Big data platforms are increasing UBA functionality by allowing them to analyze petabytes worth of data to detect insider threats and advanced persistent threats.

records.title: D3-UDTA User Data Transfer Analysis
records.description: Analyzing the amount of data transferred by a user.

records.title: D3-UGLPA User Geolocation Logon Pattern Analysis
records.description: Monitoring geolocation data of user logon attempts and comparing it to a baseline user behavior profile to identify anomalies in logon location.

records.title: D3-UGPH User Group Permissions
records.description: Access control where access is determined based on attributes associated with users and the objects being accessed.

records.title: D3-ULA Unlock Account
records.description: Restoring a user account's access to resources by unlocking a locked User Account.

records.title: D3-URA URL Reputation Analysis
records.description: Analyzing the reputation of a URL.

records.title: D3-USICA User Session Init Config Analysis
records.description: Analyzing modifications to user session config files such as .bashrc or .bash_profile.

records.title: D3-VI Variable Initialization
records.description: Setting variables to a known value before use.

records.title: D3-VS Video Surveillance
records.description: Monitoring of physical areas via camera video feeds to deter, detect, and investigate unauthorized access and related security events.

records.title: D3-VTV Variable Type Validation
records.description: Ensuring that a variable has the correct type.

records.title: D3-WSAA Web Session Activity Analysis
records.description: Monitoring changes in user web session behavior by comparing current web session activity to a baseline behavior profile or a catalog of predetermined malicious behavior.

records.title: D3-WSAM Web Session Access Mediation
records.description: Web session access mediation secures user sessions in web applications by employing robust authentication and integrity validation, along with adaptive threat mitigation techniques, to ensure that access to web resources is authorized and protected from session-related attacks.
